free.q: Choose the word nearest in meaning to 'abundant'.
free.e: Abundant means existing in large quantities, so 'plentiful' is the closest synonym.
x² - 9 factorises to (x-3)(x+3); dividing by (x-3) leaves x+3.

free.q: A deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy?
free.e: Scurvy results from a lack of Vitamin C, which is needed for healthy gums and skin.

free.q: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to 'generous'.
free.e: Generous means giving freely, so its opposite is 'stingy'.

free.q: Which of these words is spelled correctly?
free.e: The correct spelling follows 'i before e except after c' — Receive.
